brief.headline: Binance suffers $6.3 billion crypto hack, linked to North Korea
brief.detail: More than $6 billion in crypto was stolen, prompting a race to recover the funds before North Korea-linked hackers can launder them into cash.

brief.headline: Intel suffers worst day in over 50 years
brief.detail: Intel shares fell 29% on a weak outlook, wiping $12 billion off the government's stake as investors question whether AI spending will pay off.

brief.headline: Anthropic files for IPO

brief.headline: Nasdaq 100 hits third correction of 2026
brief.detail: Investors dumped big tech stocks after disappointing earnings, putting the Nasdaq 100 on course for its third technical correction this year.

brief.headline: CD&R reportedly targets $40bn Global Payments buyout
brief.detail: According to the FT, private equity firm CD&R is targeting a buyout of Global Payments, a payments processor with an enterprise value of about $40 billion.
